# The Warthens (thewarthens.com)

> Juston and Atiya Warthen share Tech Journey (honest guides for a career change into tech) and Faith Journey (their faith story and a community for women). They also make Tech Journey Jr., a free game for kids.

## Tech Journey Jr. (for kids and parents)

- [Tech Journey Jr.](https://thewarthens.com/techjr): Free educational games for kids ages 5 to 10 that teach online safety, tech and creator careers, and cool facts. No sign-in. Includes a kit for career day tables.
- [Play the game](https://thewarthens.com/techjr/play): Pick an age group. Tech Sprouts (ages 5 to 7, read-aloud voice, picture choices) or Tech Trailblazers (ages 8 to 10).
- [Internet safety for kids: 10 simple rules by age](https://thewarthens.com/techjr/internet-safety-for-kids)
- [Safe educational games for kids: a parent's checklist](https://thewarthens.com/techjr/how-to-choose-safe-educational-games)
- [What to do when your kid is bored: 20 screen-smart ideas](https://thewarthens.com/techjr/things-to-do-when-kids-are-bored)
- [Cool tech facts for kids](https://thewarthens.com/techjr/cool-tech-facts-for-kids)
- [Black inventors and tech heroes for kids](https://thewarthens.com/techjr/black-inventors-and-tech-heroes-for-kids)
- [Women in tech and STEM for kids](https://thewarthens.com/techjr/women-in-tech-and-stem-for-kids)

## About

- [About Juston and Atiya Warthen](https://thewarthens.com/about): Who we are, why we do this, what is on the site, how we work and how we are paid.

## Tech Journey (adults changing careers)

- [Tech Journey](https://thewarthens.com/tech): Career quiz, pay snapshots, resume checklist, and Start Here guides for tech sales, cybersecurity, coding, and data analytics.
- [Hype vs. Reality: is a tech career worth it?](https://thewarthens.com/tech/guides): Honest guides to tech sales, software engineering, and cybersecurity that check training marketing against real hiring data.
- [Start learning tech for free](https://thewarthens.com/tech/start-here): Step-by-step free paths into tech sales, cybersecurity, coding, and data analytics.
- [Resume Builder](https://thewarthens.com/resume): Add your resume and a job posting (or its link) to get a tailored, scanner-friendly resume and an optional matching cover letter as PDF and Word files, built only from your real experience. Two free builds per email.
- [Free resume keyword scanner](https://thewarthens.com/resume/keyword-matcher): Paste a resume and a job posting to see which key phrases are present, almost there, or missing. Free, no sign-up.
- [Resume and cover letter guides](https://thewarthens.com/resume/guides): Short, sourced guides to tailoring a resume, passing hiring software, changing careers, and addressing a cover letter.
- [How to tailor your resume to a job description](https://thewarthens.com/resume/guides/tailor-resume-to-job-description): A 7-step process with a before-and-after example, the evidence on whether tailoring helps, and what never to do.
- [ATS-friendly resume: what hiring software actually reads](https://thewarthens.com/resume/guides/ats-friendly-resume): What applicant tracking systems do, the formatting that causes problems, and a seven-point check.
- [Career change resume](https://thewarthens.com/resume/guides/career-change-resume): The layout, the summary, and how to translate old experience honestly.
- [Who to address a cover letter to](https://thewarthens.com/resume/guides/who-to-address-a-cover-letter-to): A real name, then the hiring team, then the team you would join, and how to find a name.
- [How to find resume keywords in a job description](https://thewarthens.com/resume/guides/resume-keywords-from-job-description): Where the keywords are, the four kinds, and how to use them without lying.
- [Resume summary: how to write one](https://thewarthens.com/resume/guides/resume-summary-examples): A 4-step formula for a 2 to 3 line summary, with examples for a career changer and a new grad.
- [How long should a resume be?](https://thewarthens.com/resume/guides/how-long-should-a-resume-be): One page or two, and how to cut a resume down.
- [Resume with no experience](https://thewarthens.com/resume/guides/resume-with-no-experience): What to put on a resume with no work history.
- [How to explain a resume gap honestly](https://thewarthens.com/resume/guides/how-to-explain-a-resume-gap): What to show, what to say, and what never to do.
- [How to write a short cover letter](https://thewarthens.com/resume/guides/how-to-write-a-short-cover-letter): A 4-paragraph structure with an example.
- [1:1 coaching with Jermell Mitchell](https://thewarthens.com/tech/coaching): Career coaching with a free 15-minute intro call.

## Faith Journey

- [Faith Journey](https://thewarthens.com/faith): The Warthens' faith story and writings.
- [Topical Bible studies](https://thewarthens.com/faith/topical-study): Verse-by-verse studies on tithing, giving, and calling, checked against Scripture in context.
- [Women Who Seek](https://thewarthens.com/faith/women-who-seek): A community for women, hosted by Atiya.
- [Present but Missing: a Bible lesson for men](https://thewarthens.com/faith/present-but-missing): A free read-along lesson for men on being fully present, not only providing. Isaiah 58 and Matthew 23, four settings (personal pressure, home, church, community), reflection questions, Scripture, a next step for each, and an optional emailed PDF of your notes. Short link: thewarthens.com/present.
- [Our Kids Swallowed Magnets. This Is How We Trusted God.](https://thewarthens.com/magnets): Our video about our children swallowing magnetic beads and how we trusted God when we couldn't control the outcome, with a safety note for parents.
- [She Grew Up in Church. I Didn't. We Both Needed Jesus.](https://thewarthens.com/jesus): Our video and written testimonies of why we believe in Jesus. Atiya grew up in church and Juston did not, and we both needed him. Includes common questions and a way to share your own story.
- [Source of Life: Praise Him anyway](https://thewarthens.com/source-of-life): An interactive Scripture study (King James Version) on God as the source of life and in control of the good, the bad, and the evil. A short paradigm test, three acts (Know Him, See Him, Come to Him), a searchable verse library, a worksheet for taking accountability, honest questions, and a path for people who are hurting.
